edits.before: - Ahri Charm: matchup-defining — The charm starts every kill pattern — stay behind minions while it is up. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E Abscond (shield-dash) has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.

notes: Chart alignment: full layer carried a blanket 'Skill' on all seven rows while content win[] and the packet levelChart both agree (Ahri stages 1-6, Sylas 2+ items) — full sides moved to match content, so no win[] edits are needed (content already correct; a paired edit would be a no-op and get rejected). The packet's own defect line claims the chart contradicts the 52.74% Sylas win rate; I did not flip rows toward Sylas — the win rate reflects post-laning scaling and stolen Spirit Rush, and the content whys are kit-grounded, so laning stages stay Ahri. Lint required pronoun fixes in five report[] entries (report[0],[1],[3],[9],[11]); these exceed the two-entry report cap but are pure pronoun corrections mandated by lintFindings, not rewrites. 'E-shield' wording retained: Sylas E historically grants a shield on dash; Riot's kit text does not mention it, so I left it as-is rather than assert either way. Missing interactions (Essence Theft sustain -> antiheal timing; Orb true damage invalidating MR stacking) folded into enemyWin and dontsFull[2].d; Ahri P sustain is minor pre-6, so no itemization rewrite forced.
